title: Hastings's nuclear-site UFO whistleblowers

tellings.quote: I have data of around, you know, again, 167 plus whistleblowers who are at nuclear sites all over the country coming from this guy Robert Hastings.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says he has information on more than 167 whistleblowers, people who worked at nuclear weapons sites across the United States and came forward about UFOs. He says these accounts come from a researcher named Robert Hastings, who collected them. If true, it would mean unexplained craft have shown a long interest in America's nuclear weapons.
